about.intro: Founded in late 2010s in the main campus court, the club has grown into one of the university's steadiest sporting communities — still student-run, still showing up early. Later rebranded as the YTU Flames, the club has been a regular in the regional university league.
paragraphs: We are a competitive club, not a varsity program, and that is exactly the point. Every season starts with open tryouts, every lineup is earned at practice, and every member pays dues that go straight back into travel, kit and court time.
The club runs two squads — a competitive side in the regional university league and a development side for newer players — plus open gym sessions that are open to any student, member or not.
Off the court we are family;brothers and sisters who show up for each other, on the court and off. We are a student-run club, and we are proud of it.
